text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was just another completely ordinary 
morning at the Miho Dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That's morning practice done. 
Guess I'll go take a quick shower.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Big siiiiiis!! We got big 
troubleeeeeeee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Gah!? What is it, what's the big deal?!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"It'll be faster to show you than explain! 
Please, just come over here~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah... Gyaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What on earth is this!? Everywhere 
you look, people are in an uproar! What in 
the world happened!?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It's a mouse! A mouse!! A ridiculously 
huge mouse just barged inside~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A mouse? An Umamusume making a huge fuss 
over a measly mouse—

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "Look out!! Big Sis, dodge~~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
!?!?!?! Wh-What just ran past us... A 
rat!? It was as big as a kettle!?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"I told you so, didn't I?! It's crazy, 
insanely huge! And not just that—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
TWEEEEEEET!! You there, mouse, HALT RIGHT 
THEEEERE! Entering the dorm without 
permission is against school rules!!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... It's not fair that rat gets all the 
attention! Windy-chan is gonna stand out 
too!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRASH-BAM-BOOM-BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So the kids got all riled up by 
the mouse, and that's why they're 
rampaging even more...

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, what should we do!? At this rate, 
the dorm's gonna get wrecked~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's a no-brainer! There's only one 
thing I can do.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *exhaaaale*...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Everyone, calm down!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume of Tracen Academy has no 
business squawking and whining so 
disgracefully!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Remember how you feel when you run! 
There's no way you'd lose to some little 
mouse, right?!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Big Sis, she silenced 
everyone with a single shout...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, looks like you're good now. 
Well then, right to it—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Let's show that kettle-wearing rat just 
how terrifying Miho Dorm can be!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...So in the end, we're just playing 
tag?! Don't you have some kind of plan, 
Boss?!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I-It can't be helped, okay!? I don't have 
brains like Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, thanks to everyone working 
together, we cornered that damn rat...!”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, how should I whip this naughty 
girl into shape...?

text_block_list.name: Kettle Rat
text_block_list.text: Kyu... Kyu-kyu!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaaaaaah!! It came right this 
wayaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that way has someone who can't handle 
mice...! Damn it, at this rate I can't 
escape—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
N-No... We are Miho Dormitory horse 
girls!! When it comes to running... we 
won't lose!!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That's it, drive 'em straight toward Big 
Sis! She'll take care of the rest!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! You're not getting past me!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Then let's block the way together...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You guys...!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Now's the time, Big Sis!! Catch 'eeem, 
pleeeaaase!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, bring it on, you rat! It's you 
and me, one-on-one~~~~!!" || "Hell yeah, 
bring it on, rat boy! It's you and me, 
one-on-one~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kettle Rat
text_block_list.text: Kyuu!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Mouse, secured~~! All righttt!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Great job, everyone! You showed real guts! 
Once we finish letting this guy outside—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Once we clean up this mess, this commotion 
will have its grand finale! Now, follow 
me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes sirrr!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"It's a one-on-one, a duel!! I'll take on 
every single mouse and troublemaker in 
sight!"

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah... Big sissss!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ――... AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Kettle Rat
text_block_list.text: Squeak squeak!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Mouse captured!! Next!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heeeey!! Where is that mouse?! Under the 
floorboards?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't try to flip the board! Bakushin 
O secured! Nexxxt!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... While they're busy, Windy-chan 
will become a mouse too! I gotta make a 
costume!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, into a mouse... I'm turning into a 
mouse?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...For now, I'm securing you! Windy 
captured! Next up, go, go, gooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—*Haa*... *haa*... Did it finally calm 
down...?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Big Sis, she solved the 
whooole thing all by herself...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...But because I went wild too, the dorm 
ended up getting completely wrecked in the 
end.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, they trusted me to be dorm head, 
so I really gotta handle things better 
than this...
